title: fix: retire the view-level `provider: 'api'` readers (objectui#12325)
body:
Fixes #12325
Clause-②: no

The view-level `provider: 'api'` data source is retired in `@objectstack/spec` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23082 ruling C, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#23160). Per the maintainer's ruling A on the card (comment 6163115077), this deletes every objectui reader of a ViewData `api` block now, while objectui still resolves spec `18.0.0-next.0`, and keeps the approvals inbox's code-built `ApiDataSource`.

## What changed

- `@object-ui/core` `resolveDataSource`: the `api` arm is gone. An `api` block is an unknown provider and gets that answer (the fallback, else `null`). `ResolveDataSourceOptions` loses `fetch` / `defaultHeaders`, which only that arm read. `ApiDataSource` stays a class; its docblock and its missing-config error now name `ApiDataSourceConfig`, not ViewData.
- `@object-ui/core` `ViewDataProvider` (file-surface extension, see below): the `api` arm, `resolveApi`, `extractRecords` and `DataFetcher.fetchUrl` are gone; an `api` config resolves as `Unknown data provider: api`.
- `@object-ui/react` `useViewData`: no `api` keying and no `apiFetch` threading.
- `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` `ObjectGantt`: no `api` adapter input, no `apiFetch` dependency, the drawer's real-record fetch and the refresh button no longer branch on `api`.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list` `ListView`: `ganttOwnsData` (true only for a gantt with an `api` block) and the matching skeleton branch are deleted, so such a view fetches its bound object like any list.
- `@object-ui/plugin-calendar` / `@object-ui/plugin-map` (file-surface extension): their `dataProvider === 'api'` branches, which only warned "not yet implemented", are deleted.
- Docs: `content/docs/plugins/plugin-gantt.mdx` and `plugin-map.mdx` sections that prescribed or described the `api` arm, the core adapters README, the gantt README, the `ViewData` docblock in `@object-ui/types`, and the approvals source's docblock.
- Changeset `.changeset/12325-retire-api-view-data.md` (`minor` for the breaking packages, per the no-major rule).

## File-surface extensions (bounded in-place fixes, same defect class)

The claim names `packages/core/src/adapters/`, `useViewData.ts`, `ListView.tsx`, `ObjectGantt.tsx`, `packages/types/src/` and the docs. Measurement found more readers of the same retired arm, so these were edited too, each a mechanical deletion of the same kind:

- `packages/core/src/data-scope/ViewDataProvider.ts` (a second ViewData union with its own `api` arm; not caught by a `provider === 'api'` grep because it is a `case 'api'`).
- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx` and `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx`: `dataProvider === 'api'` (capital P, so the PM's case-sensitive grep missed them). Against spec `main` these are TS2367 once core compiles; the gate's run 38513810543 never reached them because `@object-ui/core`'s build failed first.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/object-gantt-properties-bag-10859-b6.test.ts` and `object-grid-properties-bag-11276.test.ts`: the TS2352 errors of A2. Their "the parse authors no default" pins rode on the `api` arm's `read.method` default; they now ride on `navigation`'s defaults (spec row writes `mode: 'page'`, this face writes nothing).
- `apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts`: docblock only.

## Pins flipped (each asserts the new meaning)

- `resolveDataSource.test.ts`: an `api` block builds no `ApiDataSource` and is answered exactly like an unknown provider.
- `ViewDataProvider.test.ts`: an `api` config resolves to `Unknown data provider: api` and fetches nothing.
- `useViewData.test.tsx`: an `api` block falls back to the context DataSource and requests its URL through neither `apiFetch` nor global fetch.
- `ObjectGantt.apifetch.test.tsx` renamed to `ObjectGantt.retiredApiProvider-12325.test.tsx`: the `read` URL is requested through neither channel; with a context DataSource the chart queries `schema.objectName`.
- `ObjectGantt.test.tsx`: the api read/write-back case is removed, pointing at the file above.
- `recordSourceInputs-10394.test.tsx` (gantt), `index.recordSourceInputs-10394.test.tsx` (map), `ListView.test.tsx`: flipped to the retired meaning.
- `ObjectGantt.emptyHostData-7333.test.tsx`: the host-array cases now use the bound object as the own source.
- `ObjectGantt.discardedReloadIdentity-10036.test.tsx`: the discard pin moves from `api` to `value` (the constructing provider that remains); the "host swaps `apiFetch`" case is removed because `apiFetch` is no longer an adapter input. The mount baseline is measured rather than assumed (see Acceptance notes).

## Verification (head `93d4323`)

- Spec Main Shape Gate reproduced locally: built `@objectstack/spec` from objectstack `b5b1bf7277d6` (contains the retirement; `VIEW_DATA_API_PROVIDER_RETIRED` present in `dist/ui/index.js`), packed, injected with `node scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs inject`, then `TURBO_FORCE=true pnpm type-check --continue --concurrency=2`: 80 of 81 tasks green, the one red being `@object-ui/types` (the two TS2352 test casts). After the types-test fix, `@object-ui/types` + `@object-ui/plugin-gantt` type-check: 15/15 green on the same injected spec, and the two types test files 193/193 green there. Install then restored with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --force` (marker gone, retirement string 0 hits).
- Installed spec (`18.0.0-next.0`): type-check of core, react, types, plugin-gantt, plugin-list, plugin-calendar, plugin-map: 22/22 tasks green; types + plugin-gantt re-run after the last commit 15/15.
- vitest: every changed test file, 13 files / 460 tests green; approvals inbox (`approvalRequestsDataSource*.test.*`, 4 files) plus neighbouring `api` pins (ApiDataSource, record-source neutrality, ObjectView protocol keys, tree inputs, grid data contract, ListView 7477) green; earlier whole-package runs of plugin-gantt, plugin-map, plugin-calendar green.
- Reverse validation of the narrowed `ResolveDataSourceOptions`: passing `{ fetch: undefined }` from `ObjectGantt` gives TS2353 against the rebuilt `dist` (whose `.d.ts` has no `fetch`); restored, hash equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Gates (exit codes): phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, doc-json, doc-snippets, doc-examples, new-line-citations, changeset-fixed, changeset-presence, changeset-no-major: all 0. `check:spec-floors`: 1, the known unrelated "scan collapsed" red carried by objectui#12334.
- Lint narrowed to the 23 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files (count from `eslint --format json`): 0 errors. The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change any untouched file's verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- A block that still says `provider: 'api'` is not refused by objectui at runtime: under spec `18.0.0-next.0` it parses, and the renderers answer it as an unknown provider (gantt and `useViewData` fall back to the context adapter and `objectName`; map and calendar draw nothing). The refusal lands with the spec pin bump, where `ViewDataSchema` rejects it. Measured: no objectui metadata writes `provider: 'api'`.
- An inline `value` gantt reads its items more than once while mounting (measured in the moved 10036 pin). Pre-existing and unrelated to this change; the pin measures its baseline instead of hard-coding one.
- Stale prose left alone, outside this file surface: `SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch`'s docblock and `packages/react/README.md` still say it serves `provider: 'api'` view data (it still serves other channels); `ConsoleShell.tsx`, `createAuthenticatedFetch.ts` and `packages/auth/README.md` comments likewise; the `DataSource required for object/api providers` error text (pinned by the schema-catalog render test); the `plugin-grid` `data` input description, which still lists `{ provider: "api", read, write }`.
- Tests that parse `provider: 'api'` through the spec (`gridDataInputContract`, `objectTreeInputs-11168`, the two types probe lists) will need flipping at the spec pin bump; they are not readers.
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-calendar.mdx` lists the `api` config among shapes the calendar refuses; still true, left as is.
